description: agent.import admits a card that carries no signature only when the person says yes: `acceptUnsigned: true` is that yes, for this one import (the app asks them to confirm in a dialog), and the daemon imports it marked `signed: false` and `origin: import`, so it stays marked as the unsigned import it is. Without the yes — and with the operator's standing `agents.allowUnsignedImport` off — the card is refused by name. The yes is never remembered: the next unsigned card asks again.
